description: v0.05 RELEASE-SNAPSHOT/README.md contained explanatory snapshot-directory text rather than the release-time root README.md bytes expected by the v0.05 manifest. The defect remained latent while live README matched v0.05 and surfaced only after legitimate successor README changes.
governance: Repair only the broken version-local snapshot copy; do not alter v0.05 manifest, contract, package snapshot, ledgers, or release decision.
reconstruction_method: Reverse only the deterministic v0.06.1 README edits from the live successor README; resulting bytes independently match the exact v0.05 manifest-declared SHA-256 and byte count.
